value.answer: Keep the lead-up the same every time: dim the lights, same few steps in the same order, then into the room. Try to catch him when he starts rubbing his eyes or getting grumpy, because a kid who's already overtired often fights sleep harder. If you can, put him down a little awake so he learns to settle himself. How old is he? The trick changes a lot between a baby and a toddler.
